description: Ledger of what each decision was measured or derived from, the places where the written specs disagree with the implemented QA-verified code (the implemented value wins), carried-over ambiguities, scope reductions and the classifier runs that validate the template partition. Citations are path:line ranges plus an anchor string that must occur inside the range; verify_all.py resolves them against the sibling source tree and degrades to a WARNING when that tree is absent.

sourceSnapshot.note: The clone source was being edited concurrently (responsive fix for 1024-1279, more motion and QA passes). Counts and citations were computed in a final pass and re-diffed immediately before packaging.

corrections.note: route evidence level is derived, not measured

ambiguities.text: Tablet 768-1023 was never measured on the original; the clone stacks below 1024. The band 1024-1279 is its own state: the clone added a wide (1280) breakpoint because the original keeps many blocks in their tablet or stacked layout until 1280; the responsive fix was still landing at the snapshot date (each section records desktop-narrow with its evidence level).
TOC sidebars disappear below 1024 (inferred from the 390 layout and the grid; the exact breakpoint was not tested).
Gated content (product tours, policy calendar, downloads) was measured only in its pre-submit state; post-submit states were never triggered.
WebGL canvases (hero landscape, agents glow, energy forecast) cannot be read through the DOM; static CSS or PNG stand-ins are used.

Mobile coverage: measured at 390 for hero, text-with-image, carousels, quote, content cards, FAQ, page links, ordered list, logos, customers index, customer story, blog index and post, gated landing, hero-with-form (demo), sidebar index and legal; compare, LP and bespoke blocks follow the global mobile rules and were mostly measured at 1440 only.
Customers grid cells: both logo and title are in the DOM; the resting state is assumed to be the logo with the title and footer on hover (not screenshot-verified).
TextWithImageOrderedList step numerals may be pseudo-element counters; the clone draws a cobalt mono numeral.
SectionTextBlock Annotation margin notes render off-screen at 1440 and are not rendered there; the clone shows them inline below 1024.
Blog search did not filter on typing during sampling; the clone submits on Enter (unverified).
Three routes could not be fetched during recon: /platform/disclosures/rfp-guide, /platform/disclosures/secr and /events/sb-253-sb-261-senator-wiener; their templates are inferred from siblings.
Customer-story variant A/B assignment is by sampled slug pattern (13 sampled).
Event pages: 12 of 180 sampled; summit and demo-redirect variants exist and there may be more bespoke summit pages. Summit 390 is an approximation.
Resources and Company nav dropdown contents were not captured individually; they share the Product panel shell.
Mobile values that look odd (7px 11px padding, 21px and 43px gaps) are the real computed values; some paddings are fluid between breakpoints.
Code and pre blocks were not present in any sampled post; unmeasured defaults are used.

scopeReductions.text: Other locales (fr, de, en-AU) are intentionally skipped: only /en-GB is built. Do not recreate them.
Job detail pages (/careers/<id>-<slug>, about 40 links from /careers) are NOT built and fall to the Pending page. A PageSpec must not link to them.
Product-tour interiors (third-party player) and the policy-calendar tool interior are not built; video and embeds are same-size placeholders with a play overlay.
WebGL backgrounds (hero landscape, agents glow, energy forecast) are static CSS or PNG stand-ins.
No cookie banner is built; third-party form internals are out of scope (plain form with the measured field geometry).

No external-domain links anywhere: Sign in is a plain button, the footer social icon is a span, customer-report cards and press rows are non-clickable; src/routing.js href() maps any http(s) URL to the home page as a safety net.

The original company copy, photography, product screenshots, customer logos, award badges and brand marks are deliberately NOT in the clone and must never be reproduced. Copy is original placeholder text for the fictional company Northwind; fonts are open-source substitutes.

Scroll-driven motion on the original (word fades and box parallax on /change, gallery tile slide-ins on /platform/marketplace) is not reproduced; the site has no parallax and no scroll reveal other than the PageLinks reveal.

evidenceLevelMeaning.measured: measured on the original at the stated viewport (1440 and 390)
evidenceLevelMeaning.derived: derived from a measured sibling or from the global mobile rules; not measured on this page
evidenceLevelMeaning.inferred: inferred from siblings or routing alone; never measured

knownGaps: Tablet 768-1023 was never measured on the original.
Only 12 of 180 event pages were sampled.
Three routes were inferred from siblings (/platform/disclosures/rfp-guide, /platform/disclosures/secr, /events/sb-253-sb-261-senator-wiener).
Summit event 390, LP testimonial and some bespoke pages are approximations.
Block-library hover nudges, FaqFullWidth and several slider moves are not wired with transitions in the clone (implementedInClone false).
